blocks.text: Runbook: plant VPN with MFA, no trusted-subnet exception

This is the working cut for WTS-4530 on April 11, 2023. Devon Hale asked for a written bound after the current path (IKEv2 VPN, password only, 64 concurrent, NPS on nps-01.whetstone.internal) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, IT Support Intern, writing for Brett Holtz, Carla Nguyen, and Owen Briggs. Primary host vpn-01.whetstone.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on skip MFA on the 10.18.0.0/16 plant subnet, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Always On VPN plus Authenticator for every remote and every after-hours plant login. No trusted-subnet bypass. I am not restating a hallway yes. skip MFA on the 10.18.0.0/16 plant subnet is out because A contractor laptop on that subnet already had a stale DNS suffix and would have walked onto fs01. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at cidr=10.18, concurrent=64, stale=1, prompts=1.6, fail=3.2, hours=0.4, users=208, weeks=3. Sibling tickets WTS-RB-2023-019 and WTS-4530-NET. I will not reopen skip MFA on the 10.18.0.0/16 plant subnet in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Carla Nguyen is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
